fields.hero_h1: Glass Porch Enclosures in Toronto and the GTA
fields.hero_subhead: Turn your porch into a year-round space. Custom glass and screen enclosures, draft-sealed and built to fit, across the GTA.
fields.overview_heading: A porch you can use in any season
fields.overview_body:
A glass porch enclosure turns an exposed porch into a comfortable 3-season room. SolidGuard builds porch enclosures across Toronto and the GTA: glass panels, screens, and an aluminum frame measured and cut to your space. Keep the view, lose the wind, bugs, and rain.

Whether you want a front porch enclosure for curb appeal or a back-porch sunroom to relax in, we design the enclosure to suit the opening. A glass porch enclosure with operable panels gives you airflow in summer and a draft-sealed space in spring and fall, and an aluminum porch enclosure frame keeps it low-maintenance for years.

faqs.question: What is a 3-season porch enclosure?
faqs.answer: A glass and screen enclosure that makes the porch comfortable in spring, summer, and fall. It seals out wind, rain, and bugs without full heating.

faqs.question: Glass or screen panels?
faqs.answer: Many porch enclosures combine both: glass for weather and warmth, screens for airflow. We design to suit how you use the space.

faqs.question: Do you build to fit my porch exactly?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every porch enclosure is measured and built to your opening, with an aluminum frame for a clean, low-maintenance finish.

faqs.question: Do you serve the whole GTA?
faqs.answer: Yes, across Toronto and the GTA.
